newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Don Pedro opens new distribution facility.
newsitem.headline: Don Pedro opens new distribution facility.

text.p: Central Azucarera Don Pedro said on Wednesday it had started the operation of its bulk handling system which will distribute and deliver sugar to its major clients.
"With the new handling system, we are able to achieve higher operating efficiencies and margins," Don Pedro chairman Pedro Roxas said in a statement.
The bulk handling system is part of the sugar firm's programme to upgrade its equipment.
Don Pedro has the second largest sugar refinery and third largest mill in the country.
